_doc: Recipes deliberately taken down to a Ghost draft. engine\publish.ps1 REFUSES to publish a slug listed here, which is the only thing stopping an ordinary publish run from silently ending a hold - it sets status=published unconditionally on update. Remove an entry with hold-recipe.ps1 -Release, then publish it on purpose.
